notes.title: Moccoletti is out! (again ?)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

     It is time! Moccoletti is now out of early access for everyone to play.
We would have wanted to release more updates before leaving early access, but being a student proved more time-consuming than expected.
But we’re not dead! And neither is Moccoletti. You can expect us to keep working on the game and bring more content. But now, it is time to celebrate! It is time…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/38461ba25e4b80c4855c8ae38a4cb83d4de82e55.png[/img]




[h2]Time to Reminisce[/h2]

     Once upon a time, back in December 2022, there was a game jam. A two-day game jam hosted by the student section, the then-named GGS. The theme was A Light in the Dark.
Two days later, Moccoletti was born and won Most Fun and Best Graphics! And it was only the beginning…
By the way, you can still find this first version on itch! The game has changed quite a bit since.
[url=https://miraclegoth.itch.io/moccoletti] The very first version of Moccoletti [/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/db29368eb2b1c849f895cd7a9a92a12c44d3981c.png[/img]
[i]And the very first screenshot of the game.[/i]

     We had big plans for our baby but did not have much time to work on it until Spring 2024. Then, with our wonderful team, we left no stones unturned, and the fruit of our labor was exhibited at the Gotland Game Conference of that year. During this occasion, it was nominated for Best Game Design and Best in Show, and won Best Presentation!
The very next Sunday, Moccoletti was available on Steam on early access.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/a7f23e3e37b1a3e990826dc0359e7d14d6629bb6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/393e2fd770ff4839b285420cc99b78e5287ca588.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/ef3109518b36d580139f9e30c11b6985496cb498.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/b72518e12297d44e5147861cff1a3d594828d72e.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/fdf33a56375ad7c8815148e4cff54c91d062b38e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/da7b7679b1471592205bbc9023e243f5280422ef.png[/img][/url]

     Since then, we have updated the game: new masks, weapons, and stages; the GGC update; 16 candle-blowing achievements; and more…

     Now, we are going on new projects (which we strongly hope you’ll be playing when it’s out), but we’re not abandoning Moccoletti. We will keep working on it on the side, adding content, and listening to all your feedback to make the game the best version of itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/74c58cb641f31962066e3bf5ea8ccbe116e036e0.png[/img]

notes.title: Moccoletti goes pop
notes.notes:
[h1]The Autumn's Tale[/h1]

[i]Hi, hello and welcome back to our humble theatrical establishment for this turn-of-the-season performance! Tonight we are debuting a brand new stage, with a brand new player... And brand new bubbles! Before we start though, we have tried swatting all the bugs we could find - please tell us if you find more under your seats. With that, pick your mask, pick your weapon, light your candle and step on stage...

We are really happy to bring you this new update - we are full of ideas but can only work on the game on and off - so it is always exciting when we can bring you something new. We do however plan for some more things before the end of the year, so enjoy your bubbles, and stay tuned!

See you at tonight's performance!
Mira
[/i]

[h1]Bug fixing:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Screens with resolution above 1920x1080 would display the game small in the corner with the glasses under it, and the rest in black.
[*] Game crashed if you pressed confirm on screen size in the options.
[*] The “Romeo & Juliet” achievement was not obtainable.
[*] The “Training Wheels” achievement would crash the game if a player was killed by a balloon.
[*] The “Blaze of Glory” and “Shy” achievements would unlock if you exited a fight through the pause menu.
[*] Two walls were misaligned in the Maze scene.
[/list]





[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Replaced the default cancel keyboard button to the escape key instead of the alt key.
[*] Change the name “Options” to “Fight Settings” to access the settings for the fight.
[*] Added controller shake when using weapons.
[*] Removed some statues in the Statue Garden.
[*] Changed the motion of the snuffer to improve the feel of the swing.
[*] Added embers to the actors’ candles on the victory screen.
[*] New visuals for the hedges.
[*] Changed the saturation and brightness of the ground.
[*] Bauta got a nose job.
[*] Added a star on Signora Notte’s night sky.
[*] Tweaked the design of some characters’ candleholders.
[*] Added a shadow under the candle holders in the tutorial.
[*] Added a new fighting music: The Nutcracker Suite (Tchaikovsky), Act I, N°.4., Russian Dance.
[/list]





[h1]New mask: Inverna [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/83491bbb244c5fee30cfa57e2c1f2d826ecf03a4.gif[/img]
[i]There was a lady in Milan
Who fell in love with a snowman
He was such a freeze
A kiss made her sneeze
So hard she flew straight in our curtain [/i]

Please give her a warm welcome.






[h1]New weapon: Bubble Pipe[/h1]

[i]We asked some members of the troupe what they thought bubbles could be a metaphor of:
Signora Notte: Life
Sun & Moon: Youth
Gnaga: Love
Jester: Fun
The accountant: Our budget.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/22dbef36bc2aac4c6d9656f801c0fffea834ec4e.png[/img]
The bubble pipe shoots a stream of bubbles for a maximum of 2 seconds. The player must then release the attack button to let their character catch their breath. Bubbles deal 3 damage and give a little knockback by popping. They will also pop naturally after a maximum of 6 seconds.
Bubbles can also be pushed using wind, snuffer and swatter and will bounce against other bubbles. They will also bounce against walls twice and pop the third time. If the bubbles are caught in a wall, they will pop.
The colour of the bubbles depends on the team.





[h1]New scene: the Island[/h1]

[i]There are countless islands withing the Venetian lagoon; tonight, there will be one more! For the greatest pleasure of the audience, our dedicated actors will perform on a brand-new stage, the aptly named Island. After all, isolated pieces of land have often been the theatre of strange adventures: Robinson Crusoe (Daniel Defoe), L’Île des Esclaves (Marivaux), Treasure Island (Robert Louis Stevenson), The Mysterious Island (Jules Vernes)… and now your adventures![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/4dec1bd266e1ce11249469d3b9691ae3f84e1fd8.png[/img]




[h1]Seeing through the darkness[/h1]

Before this update, you could set the darkness on stage to be transparent, which was useful to see the stage especially for new players. However, the characters were then visible through the dark when they were sneaking, rendering the sneaking mechanic useless.
Now, characters do not show through the dark, allowing both sneaking and seeing the stage.

[list]
[*] New option to choose whether wind and bubble show or not in the dark in the Fight Settings > Misc > Wind visible.
[*] Default darkness opacity set to 0.9 out of 1 (fully opaque darkness).
[/list]

notes.title: Back to the game !
notes.notes:
[i]Hi everyone !
After a long summer filled with "vacation", it's Moccoletti time again! We are back in the kitchen to cook some updates for the months to come. We're starting slow with changes to the gameplay, but achievements are now in the game! Hope you'll have fun trying to unlock them all!

And without further ado, here's what is different now:[/i]

[h2]Bug fix & changes:[/h2]
-	Bug in the main menu where the music volume slider wouldn’t slide.
-	Still in the music volume menu, when going to 0 then back up, the crowd volume wouldn’t go up in volume.
-	Adjusted the distance of the wind in the selection menu to correspond to the one in game.
-	In the menu, the blow-dryer would not play the blow-dryer sound.
-	Fully removed the “wind effect”, i.e. wind that did no damage and just served to display more wind. Only affected the balloon exhaust and the blow-dryer.
-	Modified the depth system.


[h2]New Content:[/h2]

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]
-	Discover our 16 new achievements and try to unlock them all! From win conditions to (happy ?) accidents during the game, there are many ways to get rewarded.

[h3]Ghosts[/h3]
-	When pressing the sneak button, ghosts can now increase the size of their glow to find hiding players. Time to be petty and chase the oaf who dared snuff your candle.

[h3]Control remap[/h3]
-	Players can now remap controls for a better playing experience, both on controllers and on keyboard.

notes.title: Gotland Game Conference Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug fix & changes:[/h1]

- When players were done with the tutorial, the game would break. (thank you Sebastian)
- Players were not able to move the window in windowed mode.
- Ghost push is now visible.
- When a ghost uses their push, their transparency now follows a curve to better show the cooldown.





[h1]New Content:[/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/d0e7720dbeeb1d4a75616c7cf807fa154a4a569c.gif[/img]
[h2]New mask[/h2]

Freshly fished by Buranese fisherman in the Venetian Lagoon, Calamaro is the new addition to the Moccoletti troupe. After escaping the nets they were caught in, they stole and pair of shoes to wander incognito through the city. Now on land and not nowing what to do, they noticed a recruitment poster for a nearby theatre. Since the director didn’t see anything fishy in the applicant, Calamaro is now here and ready to snuff some candles!



[h2]New weapon:[/h2]

To celebrate the opening of the play, the troupe has been hanging balloons in the theatre. The task is not without incident though, and Dottore, as the man of science he is, saw in the deflating balloons a new way to entertain the audience.

- Hold the attack button to inflate the balloon and release it to send the balloon flying.
- When released, you can stir the balloon using the right stick. The lifespan of the balloon will depend on its charge.
- If you hold the attack ballon for too long (4 seconds), the balloon will explode and damage all players around it.
- If the balloon gets caught inside walls, it will get pierced by branches and explode.
- As soon as your previous balloon has disappeared, you can charge a new one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/1879d9117748b0e17dc4999130664492e1200e89.gif[/img]




[h1]The Gotland Game Conference (GGC):[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/52a6ef8548b24787af8faed6ef35b6da3252c271.png[/img]
Moccoletti was at the GGC, won the Best Presentation award and was even nominated for Best Game Design and Best in Show. To celebrate the presence of Moccoletti at the GGC, some special features have been added, which can enabled and disabled in the options menu.

- New Mask: Gigi, mascot of GGC, makes an appearance on stage. She will make sure the game is good!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/b65e1d31a7476ce31315abace59bc696d21c439c.gif[/img]

- New skin for the weapon: the ballon was originally meant to be GGC exclusive content, but players really seemed to like its convoluted use. So here you go! The balloon is now a permanent weapon, but turning on GGC will give it a different appearance. (Shameless plug? Us? Never!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029934/07cf9293afb1053be602d72cae1690d5c9c889f4.gif[/img]

- New Arena: explore the show floor of the GGC and the games hosted there. Find references to 11 games exhibited at GGC:
[list]
[*] The little tree spirits from [url=https://shuvinolife.itch.io/rot]ROT! [/url]
[*] Dancing crabs from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_0EzrsE4O1s&list=PLIi3cUheyrORchjekXUTWpLpUlbOHR192&index=17]CrabStep[/url]
[*] Cockroaches from [url=https://jackdaww.itch.io/metamorph]Metamorph[/url]
[*] Dip & Dop from Levels of Attraction
[*] A rune circle from To Save a Soul
[*] A saxophone-playing rat from [url=https://love64.itch.io/jazz-of-the-undeground]Jazz of the Underground[/url]
[*] A monster statue from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JiWKPqFCXN8&list=PLIi3cUheyrORchjekXUTWpLpUlbOHR192&index=25]Forces of Nature[/url]
[*] A wizard statue from [url=https://weissyuki.itch.io/recitallion]Recitallion[/url]
[*] A beautifull tapestry representing the gest of [url=https://odins-defense.itch.io/odins-defense]Odin’s Defense[/url]
[*] Two divers from [url=https://birkv37.itch.io/atlantean-descent]Atlantean Descent[/url]
[*] A cat in a box (alive or dead?) from Schrödinger
[/list]

notes.title: Moccoletti is Out!
notes.notes:
Hi fan club!

Our beloved child, GGC award winning theatre stealth fighter Moccoletti is now available on Steam in early access!
Get it on launch discount now and find out if the whoopie cushion is mightier than the fly swatter, or if the snuffer can match the power of the trumpet.

Keep an eye out for our updates throughout 2024!
